title.en: The Household Ledger and the Merchants Council

desc.zh: 海口税关的账册摊在王府长案上，船主代表坐在下首。摆上桌的不是现成银款，而是三种本国办法：公开账目争取信用、以王府名义担保，或由商界提出优先报关的条件。每条路都先缴本国登记费。
desc.en: The customs ledgers lie across the household table, with shipowners below. No outside purse is on offer: the choices are domestic terms—open the books in pursuit of credit, put the household name behind a guarantee, or propose priority clearance for merchants. Each route begins with the country’s filing fee.
